barRaise.topFinding: Eighteen runs in, the two-surface exposure is not partially fixed, it is entirely unshipped. deploy-pages.yml was re-read line by line this run and contains no delete step at all, so the 2026-07-26 remedy that last run described as closing the smaller of two surfaces never landed: zero of two are closed, not one. All eight exposed URL classes answer 200 on both yesandeverything.com and raw.githubusercontent.com at byte-identical sizes, and gh repo view still reports isPrivate: false. The payload keeps growing: the served .work-queue.json went 1,071 KB to 1,118 KB and 420 to 444 items in one day, the archive went 1,050 KB to 1,121 KB, and the served queue now names Skylight 349 times against 317 yesterday. Third consecutive run closing zero findings. The corrected order is already in the queue: back the queue up outside this public repo, untrack both backup-bearing files, then re-fetch on Pages AND raw and confirm 404 on both.
